name: Situbondo

queries.query: Situbondo Indonesia official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS ATR BPN
queries.result: First-party discovery identified ATR/BPN BHUMI and ATLAS as the national public geospatial/land-information portals, and the official Kabupaten Situbondo geoportal and LokaGeo WebGIS as local government map sources. BHUMI documentation describes a public Bidang Tanah layer with parcel geometry and attributes, but the exposed workflow is identifier-based and no anonymous parcel feature response was obtained for the city point.

queries.query: Situbondo portal resmi pertanahan peta bidang tanah ATR BPN; Kabupaten Situbondo geoportal resmi data spasial bidang tanah
queries.result: Penelusuran sumber pertama berbahasa Indonesia menemukan BHUMI/ATLAS ATR/BPN, dokumentasi fitur pencarian bidang tanah dan katalog data, serta portal LokaGeo Kabupaten Situbondo. LokaGeo exposes administrative and thematic layers but not a public parcel layer in the inspected page. No safe anonymous response containing a native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained.

registryEvidence.custodian: Kementerian Agraria dan Tata Ruang/Badan Pertanahan Nasional (ATR/BPN), via BHUMI/ATLAS, with Pemerintah Kabupaten Situbondo geoportal/LokaGeo as the local map custodian.
registryEvidence.locality: Situbondo, Jawa Timur, Indonesia; local portal scope is Kabupaten Situbondo and the cadastral service is national ATR/BPN.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: A first-party public cadastral map service is evidenced through ATR/BPN BHUMI, and a first-party local Situbondo geospatial portal is evidenced. This establishes source/procedure evidence, not a city-specific anonymous parcel response or complete coverage claim.
